india_trends.title: Cupid makes additional $5 million investment in GII Healthcare platform
india_trends.summary: Cupid has invested an additional $5 million in GII Healthcare Investment Limited, reinforcing its belief in the healthcare sector's growth. The investment, made entirely from internal funds, enhances Cupid's commitment to GII's long-term strategy without disclosing its stake size.
